TRANSFER OF RESIDENCE (BAGGAGE) RULES, 1979
TRANSFER OF RESIDENCE (BAGGAGE) RULES, 1979
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part Il, 7th February 1980]
S. R. O. 150 (I)/80.-In exercise of the powers conferred by
section 219 of the Customs Act, 1969 (IV of 1969), the Central Board of Revenue
is pleased to make the following amendments in the Transfer of Residence
(Baggage) Rules, 1979, namely :-
In the aforesaid Rules, in rule 3, in sub-rule (i),------
(a) in clause (i), after the word "air-conditioner", the
words and figure "up to I i ton capacity" shall be added; and
(b) in clause (ii), after the word "freezer", the words
and figure "up to
10 cubic feet" shall be added.
The amendments made by this notification shall take effect on the
18th March 1980.
[S. No. 4/80 C. No. 1978-79/Cus/L&P/5/(65)].
